summary: Rezones 0.73 acres at 3000, 3002, 3008, 3012 and 3016 Clifton Avenue, at the corner of 32nd Avenue North, from RS5 to a Specific Plan (SP) district allowing 12 detached multi-family homes. Short term rentals are prohibited, and the plan sets conditions on building looks, setbacks, fire access and private driveways.
